name: token-weather
description: A live dashboard of your context window and prompt cache above the prompt, in the analogy and language you pick

analogy.title: Analogy
analogy.description: How the band pictures the context fill: weather, moon, hearts, fuel, pot, tide, daytime or volcano

cache.title: Cache row
cache.description: Show the prompt cache: full (its own row), compact (appended to the forecast) or off

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request: 1h or 5m

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band: en, de, es, it or fr
